<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>true</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>true</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Book A Metro Ticket">72cbd0ee83c70310843fcfd6feaad30d</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:35c2606e830b0310843fcfd6feaad385</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Fare Auto-Calculation</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {

    if (isLoading || newValue == '') {
        return;
    }

    // Get Source and Destination
    var source = g_form.getValue('starting_from');
    var destination = g_form.getValue('going_to');

    // Passenger Count
    var numPassengers = Number(newValue);

    // Get Journey Type
    var journeyType = g_form.getValue('type_of_journey');


    // Ameerpet → Madhapur
    if (source == '96eb402283870310843fcfd6feaad383' &&
        destination == 'f01c08ee83470310843fcfd6feaad302') {

        if (journeyType == '1') {

            // ₹30 per passenger
            g_form.setValue(
                'amount_for_single_journey',
                numPassengers * 30
            );

            g_form.clearValue('amount_including_return');

        } else if (journeyType == '2') {

            // ₹60 per passenger
            g_form.clearValue('amount_for_single_journey');

            g_form.setValue(
                'amount_including_return',
                numPassengers * 60
            );
        }
    }


    // Ameerpet → LB Nagar
    else if (source == '96eb402283870310843fcfd6feaad383' &&
             destination == 'cd2c082283870310843fcfd6feaad3da') {

        if (journeyType == '1') {

            // ₹50 per passenger
            g_form.setValue(
                'amount_for_single_journey',
                numPassengers * 50
            );

            g_form.clearValue('amount_including_return');

        } else if (journeyType == '2') {

            // ₹100 per passenger
            g_form.clearValue('amount_for_single_journey');

            g_form.setValue(
                'amount_including_return',
                numPassengers * 100
            );
        }
    }


    // Ameerpet → Kukatpally
    else if (source == '96eb402283870310843fcfd6feaad383' &&
             destination == '479b08ee83470310843fcfd6feaad393') {

        if (journeyType == '1') {

            // ₹30 per passenger
            g_form.setValue(
                'amount_for_single_journey',
                numPassengers * 30
            );

            g_form.clearValue('amount_including_return');

        } else if (journeyType == '2') {

            // ₹60 per passenger
            g_form.clearValue('amount_for_single_journey');

            g_form.setValue(
                'amount_including_return',
                numPassengers * 60
            );
        }
    }


    // Ameerpet → Jubilee Hills
    else if (source == '96eb402283870310843fcfd6feaad383' &&
             destination == 'bdbbc8ee83470310843fcfd6feaad34d') {

        if (journeyType == '1') {

            // ₹20 per passenger
            g_form.setValue(
                'amount_for_single_journey',
                numPassengers * 20
            );

            g_form.clearValue('amount_including_return');

        } else if (journeyType == '2') {

            // ₹40 per passenger
            g_form.clearValue('amount_for_single_journey');

            g_form.setValue(
                'amount_including_return',
                numPassengers * 40
            );
        }
    }


    // No matching route
    else {

        g_form.clearValue('amount_for_single_journey');
        g_form.clearValue('amount_including_return');
    }
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-04 06:54:15</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>09349cf683878310843fcfd6feaad3f3</sys_id><sys_mod_count>5</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Fare Auto-Calculation</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_09349cf683878310843fcfd6feaad3f3</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-09 13:10:37</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

function onSubmit() {
    // Prevent execution if spModal is unavailable (Native UI)
    if (typeof spModal === 'undefined') {
        return true; 
    }

    var sysId = g_form.getUniqueValue();
    var dummyURL = 'https://example.com/ticket?id=' + sysId;
    var qrImageUrl = 'https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=250x250&data=' + encodeURIComponent(dummyURL);

    spModal.open({
        title: "Your Metro QR Ticket — click Checkout once more to confirm",
        widget: "metro_qr_widget",
        widgetInput: { qr_url: qrImageUrl }
    }).then(function() {
        metroQrDone = true;
    });

    return false; 
}
]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-04 11:55:16</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>bd495db283cf8310843fcfd6feaad36e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>7</sys_mod_count><sys_name>QR Generation</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_bd495db283cf8310843fcfd6feaad36e</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-09 13:12:45</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onSubmit</type><ui_type>1</ui_type><va_supported>false</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
